Blocks.Section: VAST Tag Video Ads API
Blocks.Text: VAST Tag Video Ads enable the use of third-party hosted video content through standardized VAST Tags. This ensures compatibility across the LinkedIn Audience Network and open real-time bidding platforms.

Blocks.Section: VAST Tag Video Ads API
Blocks.Text: Create and manage VAST Tag Video Ads using the external Creatives API. VAST Tag Video Ads include a VAST Tag URL. Only place them on the Connected TV i.e. LinkedIn Audience Network. You must set connectedTelevisionOnly and offsiteDeliveryEnabled to true in the campaign schema.

Blocks.Section: Requirements
SectionPath: Requirements
Blocks.Text: To create VAST Tag Video Ads, you must meet the following requirements. For complete specifications, refer to the VAST Tag Video Ads Specifications.

Blocks.Section: Permissions
SectionPath: Permissions

Rows.Text: Manage and read an authenticated member's Ad Accounts. To sponsor an image, the authenticated member must meet both of the following conditions: Be an ADMINISTRATOR of a Company Page or a DIRECT_SPONSORED_CONTENT_POSTER with access to Campaign Manager. Have one of the following Ad Account roles: ACCOUNT_BILLING_ADMIN,ACCOUNT_MANAGER, CAMPAIGN_MANAGER, CREATIVE_MANAGER
Values: Be an ADMINISTRATOR of a Company Page or a DIRECT_SPONSORED_CONTENT_POSTER with access to Campaign Manager.
Have one of the following Ad Account roles: ACCOUNT_BILLING_ADMIN,ACCOUNT_MANAGER, CAMPAIGN_MANAGER, CREATIVE_MANAGER

Rows.Text: Read an authenticated member's Ad Account. Restricted to Ad Accounts where the authenticated member has one of the following Ad Account roles: ACCOUNT_BILLING_ADMINACCOUNT_MANAGERCAMPAIGN_MANAGERCREATIVE_MANAGERVIEWER

Blocks.Text: Schema for entire creative is similar to Creatives, only the content field now supports a VAST Tag Video Ad content for the creation and management of VAST Tag Video Ads.
